options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions. Optional on 2.0.22/5002322; explicit Quest Pro and Pico profiles populate exact Galaxy XR product entries.
name: Device identity

options.description: Recommended uses Meta Quest Pro on exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244 (including 5001712), and Galaxy XR otherwise. Explicit profiles override that choice. Native-XR routing and verified legacy payloads are preserved.
options.title: HMD identity

description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.
name: Force HMD initialization gates

description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.
name: Force lobby permission-state gate

description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in builds 5001712, 5001740, and 5002244. Build 5002313 rewrote XrSceneStream::Init and is intentionally left unchanged.
name: Force stream XR gates

description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, 5002296, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on 2.0.20/5001712; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.
name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
description: Selects the 17-patch Galaxy XR legacy set, including Meta Quest Pro identity, native gates, face bridge, OLED calibration, microphone, battery, Visual Delay, explicit startup permissions and splash, and XR foundation. High-resolution output is guarded to verified layouts; unavailable on 5001740.
name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
description: Applies the 17-patch Galaxy XR legacy set for exact Steam Link 2.0.20 build 5001712, including explicit startup permissions and splash, Meta Quest Pro identity, permission-free high resolution, and the Final balanced tested OLED profile.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001712)

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
description: Applies the 9-patch Galaxy XR set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002318, including separately listed startup permissions and splash/XR launch mode.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002318)

description: Applies the 6-patch Galaxy XR set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002322. Preserves stock startup and permission requests except battery settings; includes the Final balanced tested OLED profile.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002322)

description: For exact older Steam Link builds only. Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest. See the [GXR Face Bridge source](https://github.com/compdoge/gxr-face-bridge) and matching [Galaxy XR VRCFT module](https://github.com/compdoge/LinkFT).
name: GXR face bridge (version 5002318 and below)

description: For modern Steam Link builds with Valve's native Android XR face mapping. Currently verified and enabled only for exact build 5002322; newer builds require a separately verified native layout. Preserves Valve's face expressions and standard TongueOut while exposing Galaxy XR tongue out/left/right/up/down to the matching Galaxy XR VRCFT module.
name: GXR tongue bridge (version 5002322 and above)

description: Selects the Android AAudio microphone processing mode used by Steam Link. Galaxy XR testing found Voice Recognition clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.
name: Microphone input preset

options.description: Voice Recognition was the clearest usable-level mode in Galaxy XR recordings. Voice Performance and Unprocessed were substantially quieter; Voice Communication sounded more processed.
options.title: Microphone mode

description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Selects the gamma and saturation pair used in the 1087-byte video shader.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

options.description: Compare sRGB8, RGB10_A2, and FP16 projection storage. Linear formats include sRGB conversion. FP16 support and performance are unverified; unsupported formats may prevent streaming. These choices do not force compositor or panel depth. Use Neutral calibration for comparisons.
options.title: Video output precision

options.description: Adds fine noise after calibration, before linear conversion. Preserves exact black/white and fades noise near endpoints. Compare gradients, grain and shimmer. This is app-side noise, not final compositor dithering or proof of extra panel bits.
options.title: Comparison dithering

description: Requests hand, eye and face tracking, microphone and Bluetooth permissions before opening Steam Link on exact older builds. Battery settings and the visible startup splash are separate patches.
name: Startup permission requests (before 5002322)

description: Adds the Launching Steam Link splash, older-build panel sizing and explicit unmanaged VRLink startup. Does not request tracking, microphone or Bluetooth permissions; select Startup permission requests separately.
name: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)

description: Opens Android's per-app Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.
name: Unrestricted battery usage

description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths. Its trampoline uses a dedicated executable mapping over non-runtime ELF comment bytes and preserves live PLT entries.
name: Visual Delay Fix

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so: AArch64 MOVZ/MOVK at PLT cave adds value×1e6 ns to X2 in QSVLDeviceHmd::GetPose. Tested default: 60 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
options.title: Pose offset (ms)
